scientific limitations/integrity: The proof is symbolic. It uses the classical von Staudt--Clausen theorem, Adams' Bernoulli numerator theorem, Dirichlet's theorem on primes in progressions, and the standard class-number-one argument for Q(sqrt(3)). The bundled computation checks only finite arithmetic, primality, minimality candidates, and congruence bookkeeping; it is not used as a substitute for the infinite theorems. The exact criterion concerns the P_2 class only and does not classify the other prime classes introduced in the source.
title: An Adams-theorem criterion for Svinin's Bernoulli prime class
